title: hmmbuild tau on the PANTHER sets matches the original run
body:
Rerun hmmbuild for the three original data sets and compare the result with the original TSVs, row by row.

## Proposal

For each of training at seed 42, training at seed 21 and held-out at seed 42, run `hmmbuild --cpu 1 --singlemx --seed N -o /dev/null <out.hmm> <one-seq.fa>` on every sequence. Write `seq_id`, `length`, `tau` and `lambda` in input order, with tau as minus mu. Then match each row to the original TSV by `seq_id` and count rows whose tau or lambda differ.

A smoke test on the first 20 training sequences at seed 42 matched the original exactly on every row. `--informat afa` makes no difference to the result.
